title: A staker who should fall to tier 3 stays recorded in tier 2
rootCause: When a tier 3 staker leaves and the tier 2 size does not change, LayerEdgeStaking._checkBoundariesAndRecord records the rank at the new boundary, while the staker who actually crossed it sits one rank lower, so that staker keeps the tier 2 record and its rate.

poc.observable: test_the_staker_pushed_out_of_tier_two_is_recorded_as_tier_three fails with "the tier recorded for the seventh staker: 2 != 3"
